scripts.lint: eslint src tests e2e e2e-cross e2e-multiplayer e2e-pwa server && tsc --noEmit
scripts.screenshot: npm run build && playwright test e2e/screenshot.spec.ts --grep @perf --workers=1 --retries=0 && MEXE_KEEP_VERIFY_LOG=1 playwright test e2e/screenshot.spec.ts --grep-invert @perf
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run screenshot && node scripts/check-verify.mjs
scripts.test:multiplayer: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.multiplayer.config.ts
scripts.test:multiplayer:chromium: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.multiplayer.config.ts --project=chromium --grep-invert "@chaos|@endurance"
scripts.verify:cross: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.cross.config.ts
scripts.verify:pwa: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.pwa.config.ts
scripts.verify:visual: npm run build && playwright test e2e/visual.spec.ts --workers=1 --retries=0
